findings.finding: Redacting schema-required public evaluator-contract metadata made the analysed HDP invalid and non-recompilable.
findings.resolution: The generated source now embeds the exact declared public contract; private evaluator cases and implementations remain outside all HDP inputs. The compiler removes only the evidence-only reconstruction extension from build semantics. Exact manifest parity is tested.

findings.finding: The packager accepted caller-authored pass statuses and arbitrary evidence digest strings without recomputing their evidence.
findings.resolution: The packager now accepts a closed content-addressed raw-evidence bundle, re-reads every artifact, recomputes every digest, checks exact subject and task bindings, and derives all ten gate results deterministically.

findings.finding: Per-task live runner summaries were not accepted as canonical conformance and no eligible subject-bound release existed.
findings.resolution: The verification-bundle builder binds all four raw live aggregates to the final definition, HIR, binding, and harness subject. Packaging embeds those reports and derives canonical conformance before eligibility.

findings.finding: An earlier local verification report predated analyser/generator changes.
findings.resolution: A fresh current-4 report was produced after the fixes and records schema, compile, static, analyse, exact diff, packaging, verify, and tamper gates for the final HIR subject.

findings.finding: README referenced a verification report that had not yet been generated.
findings.resolution: The final release workflow generates docs/verification-report.md and evidence/verification-report.json after packaging read-back.

reviewBoundary: The independent reviewer issued the initial no-go and exact findings. The root agent implemented and deterministically verified remediation; this record does not claim a later independent go recommendation.
reviewProcessAnomaly: Two follow-up reviewers violated explicit read-only instructions and rewrote reviewed files; both were terminated, their changes were discarded, and the final source was re-tested without live subagents.
